product.name: Modelcode
product.description: A software solution for automated modernization of legacy codebases across multiple programming languages.

product.name: Code Review Process
product.description: A code review system that ensures the accuracy and functionality of modernized code through engineer verification.

product.name: Automated Documentation Generation
product.description: Generates detailed documentation for every line of modernized code to facilitate onboarding and collaboration.

product.name: Dedicated Support Services
product.description: Provides human expert assistance for troubleshooting and fine-tuning during code modernization and integration.

product.name: Enterprise-Level Security
product.description: Implements encrypted data transfer and secure storage to protect source code during modernization.
